item.title: Former Wichita Co. investigator's trial for child sex crimes delayed
item.description: The pending child sex crimes trial of a former investigator with the Wichita County District Attorney's office has been delayed, according to court documents.

item.title: Address reversal sparks frustration for Duncan residents
item.description: Thousands of Duncan residents are being asked to change their addresses again, less than three years after a city-led update, sparking frustration over costs, confusion, and accountability.

item.title: Driver identified in fatal semi-trailer rollover wreck near Electra
item.description: The Department of Public Safety has identified the driver killed in a wreck on U.S. 287 near Electra Monday afternoon.

item.title: Honoring Vietnam Veterans: Ceremony in Wichita Falls
item.description: All veterans who served on active duty in the U.S. Armed Forces from November 1, 1955, to May 15, 1975, regardless of duty location, will be recognized, along with local heroes.

item.title: Former Duncan jailer pleads guilty to sexual relationship with inmate
item.description: A former Oklahoma jailer has pleaded guilty to allegations that she engaged in a sexual relationship with an inmate in the Stephens County Jail.

item.title: New project in Wichita Falls turns local artwork into collectible cards
item.description: A new project in Wichita Falls is giving local artists a creative way to share their work and turning it into something people can actually collect. It's called Lucky Locals.

item.title: Man indicted on child sex crime allegation from 2019
item.description: Police arrested a man with multiple felony charges pending against him after he was formally charged with a child sex crime that allegedly took place more than seven years ago.

item.title: Nocona General Hospital expanding emergency department
item.description: A new group of emergency room physicians will begin serving patients at Nocona General Hospital starting May 1.

item.title: Duncan Area Economic Development Foundation earns national accreditation
item.description: The International Economic Development Council (IEDC) has recognized the DAEDF as an Accredited Economic Development Organization (AEDO), making it one of 93 organizations worldwide to hold the honor.

item.title: Experience the magic of The Beatles with The Fab Four in Lawton
item.description: The Emmy Award-winning Fab Four delivers an experience above other tribute bands thanks to their meticulous attention to detail.

item.title: Local coin collector says saving pennies is a waste of time
item.description: What did you do when you heard penny production would cease? Did you save them? Coin Broker Gene Wheeler says you're wasting your time.

item.title: 'Gas station heroin,' Wichita Falls PD warns of deadly synthetic, unregulated drugs
item.description: Two dangerous drugs making headlines across the country are now raising concern here in Texoma.

item.title: Remarkable Women, Silvia Martinez: Mother, living donor, entrepreneur, advocate
item.description: Silvia Martinez, a single mother of four, overcame her own physical limitations and the loss of her daughter to fentanyl to launch her own cleaning business, donate a liver to her stepfather, and co-found a nonprofit to help those battling addiction.

item.title: Burkburnett ISD celebrates Month of the Military Child
item.description: Burkburnett High School's Student 2 Student program is helping military-connected students adjust to their new environment by providing a support system and a sense of belonging.
